title: Memory Lens: Create router with annotation endpoints
completion_summary: Implemented lens router with annotate and scan endpoints, Pydantic models, error mapping, mounted in server.py
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/memory/{project}/lens/annotate accepts file_path + line_number, returns annotations
GET /api/memory/{project}/lens/scan/{file_path} returns all annotations for file
Pydantic request/response models at API boundary
Domain errors mapped to HTTP status codes
